consequence.statement: New optional ability to add custom annotations to the revision-tags MutatingWebhookConfiguration via the Helm chart; nothing breaks if the operator does nothing.

original.statement: Helm chart now lets users add custom annotations to the revision-tags MutatingWebhookConfiguration (exact values key not stated).

decision.reason: [ev-7af9fcb7190e] calls this an addition that "allow[s] user to add" custom annotations to the revision-tags MutatingWebhookConfiguration through the Helm chart. That makes it an opt-in capability. The evidence describes no change to defaults, no removal and no failure. So "none" with an informational class fits: an operator who does nothing keeps the current behaviour.
